items.q: Is the dancing banana the same as the Peanut Butter Jelly Time banana?
items.a: Yes — same banana. I made it in 1999, and it predates the song.

items.q: Who made the Peanut Butter Jelly Time banana?
items.a: I did — Trym Stene, in 1999. Others later set it to The Buckwheat Boyz’ song in a Flash animation that went viral.

items.q: Who made the Peanut Butter Jelly Time song?
items.a: The Buckwheat Boyz — the song is all theirs. The banana was already dancing when it arrived.

items.q: Can I license the banana for a project?
items.a: The banana, yes — directly from me. The song and the Flash video are owned by others and need separate permission. [How licensing works →](/license-the-dancing-banana/)

items.q: Where’s the full story of the dancing banana?
items.a: Right here: [the Dancing Banana story & download →](/dancing-banana-gif-meme/)
